name: Ame Agari no Neko-tachi e
source:
This story begins in 1990. Hitomi and Hoshibana lead the lives of 2 ordinary high school girls. Hoshibana, having distrust for all men due to a prior traumatic experience, falls in love with
Hitomi. With these complex emotions, Hoshibana continues seeing Hitomi, until one rainy day, she confronts Hitomi with her feelings. Suddenly, an accident occurs... They're buried alive in a landslide! A monument is built for these two at the school; the sorrow for these two continues...

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20020819192812fw_/http://gamelexgs.com:80/gameinfo/2001/ta/the_cats_after_rain/index.htm]gamelexgs[/url]]
translation:
故事始于1990年。瞳与星花原本只是两名普通高中女生。星花因过去的创伤而不信任所有男性，却爱上了瞳。怀着复杂的感情，她继续与瞳来往。一个雨天，她终于向瞳坦白心意，却突然发生意外…两人被山体滑坡掩埋！学校为她们建立了纪念碑，人们对二人的哀思久久延续…

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20020819192812fw_/http://gamelexgs.com:80/gameinfo/2001/ta/the_cats_after_rain/index.htm]Gamelex[/url]]
